strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_DESCRIPTION:
Cloaker uses stealth and precise gunfire to expose vulnerable targets.

<style=cSub>Choose Cloak to ambush enemies, or Akimbo to trade stealth for rapid alternating shots.</style>
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION: After <style=cIsUtility>{0} seconds out of combat</style>, become invisible and gain movement speed. While invisible, gain <style=cIsDamage>{1}% bonus damage</style>. Shooting, taking damage, or an enemy within <style=cIsUtility>{2}m</style> breaks stealth. Cooldown reduction reduces the delay.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PASSIVE_ALT1_DESCRIPTION: Replace passive stealth with <style=cIsDamage>{0}% bonus attack speed</style>. Hold Shoot to alternate pistols. Pistol hits do not apply marks.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_PRIMARY_DESCRIPTION: Fire a precise bullet for <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SECONDARY_DESCRIPTION: Charge a shot for up to <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style>. Charging takes <style=cIsUtility>{1} seconds</style>, reduced by attack speed.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_UTILITY_DESCRIPTION: Dash in your movement direction, becoming <style=cIsUtility>invincible for {0} seconds</style>. With Cloak, enter stealth and ignore damage and proximity reveals for <style=cIsUtility>{1} seconds</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SPECIAL_DESCRIPTION: Mark a target within <style=cIsUtility>{0}m</style>. The next hit is a <style=cIsDamage>guaranteed critical strike</style>, or deals <style=cIsDamage>{1}% more damage</style> if it already crits. Consumed marks cannot be reapplied for <style=cIsUtility>{2} seconds</style>.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_SPECIAL2_DESCRIPTION: Unleash a shockwave for <style=cIsDamage>{0}% damage</style> to enemies within <style=cIsUtility>{1}m</style>, knocking them back.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_LORE: An unseen threat waits for the right moment.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_BODY_LORE: An unseen threat waits for the right moment.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_OUTRO_FLAVOR: ..and so they left, unseen once more.
strings.FFTS_CLOAKER_MAIN_ENDING_ESCAPE_FAILURE_: ..and so they vanished, leaving only an echo.
